instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.before: Portion into meal-prep containers and top each with shredded cheese or a dollop of sour cream when reheating.
instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.after: Shred block cheese before using. Portion into meal-prep containers; after reheating, top with natural cheddar, plain Monterey Jack or a Mexican-style cheese blend, or a dollop of plain sour cream.

instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.before: Whisk sour cream (or blended cottage cheese/Greek yogurt) with half the shredded cheese and ½ cup chicken broth.
instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.after: Shred the cheddar if using a block. Blend plain wet-curd cottage cheese smooth if selected; otherwise use plain full-fat sour cream or plain whole-milk Greek yogurt. Whisk the selected binder with half the shredded cheddar and ½ cup chicken broth.

instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.before: Bake an additional 20–22 minutes until the selected florets are tender and cheese is bubbling golden brown.
instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.after: Bake an additional 20–22 minutes, checking that the casserole and chicken reach at least 165°F in the center on a food thermometer and the selected florets are tender; continue cooking as needed.

instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.before: Stir in half the shredded cheese (or omit for dairy-free) and pack with fresh avocado slices for serving.
instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.after: Shred block cheese before using. Omit dairy for dairy-free and pack fresh avocado slices for serving.
Full-Fat Sour Cream or Whole-Milk Plain Greek Yogurt

instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.before: For kale, simmer the chopped leaves in the broth until tender before turning off the heat. For spinach, turn off heat and stir in the leaves until wilted. Finish with sour cream (or coconut milk for dairy-free) for a rich, velvety broth.
instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.after: For kale, simmer the chopped leaves in the broth until tender before turning off the heat. For spinach, turn off heat and stir in the leaves until wilted. For the dairy finish, let the pot stop simmering, gradually whisk a little warm broth into plain full-fat sour cream or plain whole-milk Greek yogurt, then stir it gently back into the pot off heat; do not boil. Use coconut milk instead for dairy-free.
Whole-Milk Plain Greek Yogurt or Full-Fat Sour Cream

instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.before: Shred or chunk the chicken in the pot, cook the selected cauliflower florets until tender, or fold in fresh spinach until wilted, then add Greek yogurt (or full-fat coconut milk if dairy-free) until creamy, and portion into meal containers.
instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.after: Shred or chunk the chicken in the pot, cook the selected cauliflower florets until tender, or fold in fresh spinach until wilted. Turn off the heat and let simmering stop. Gradually whisk a little warm sauce into plain whole-milk Greek yogurt or plain full-fat sour cream, then stir it gently back into the pot off heat; do not boil. Use full-fat coconut milk instead for dairy-free, and portion into meal containers.

instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.before: Whisk eggs with cottage cheese (the secret to ultra-fluffy reheatable eggs that never get rubbery) and half the shredded cheddar.
instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.after: Blend the 8 oz plain wet-curd cottage cheese smooth if desired. Shred the 8 oz cheddar if using a block. Whisk eggs with all the cottage cheese and half the shredded cheddar; both dairy ingredients are required for this version.
Butter or Shredded Cheddar / Monterey Jack

instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.before: Steam or microwave cauliflower florets for 6 minutes, then blitz or mash with butter (or olive oil for dairy-free) and roasted garlic.
instructionTitleAndLabelPatches.after: Steam or microwave cauliflower florets for 6 minutes, checking until tender, then blitz or mash with roasted garlic. Off heat, stir in butter or finely shredded natural cheddar or plain Monterey Jack until melted; use olive oil instead for dairy-free.
